text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. There, Biko 
Pegasus learns that Hishi Akebono will 
make her debut in the autumn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though excited for a little break to have 
fun, the two psych themselves up to 
prioritize their training.
